report.period: 2026年9月19日—10月2日 · 尼泊尔独立版（持续更新）
report.status: 截至9月22日，本期已核验4条重要事件。每日采集用于发现候选，只有完成日期、原文与事实核验后才进入公开简报；政策表态、应急投入和技术故障均不等于已形成的采购项目。
report.statusEn: As of 22 September, four material events have been verified for this issue. Daily collection discovers candidates, but publication requires date, source and factual verification. Policy statements, emergency support and technical incidents do not by themselves constitute procurement projects.
summary: 尼泊尔电信在洪灾地区提供免费光纤设备修复、补卡和灾备链路等通信保障；这些措施已执行，但尚无新增采购预算或供应商信息。
数据中心技术故障导致尼泊尔证券交易所9月21日停市，券商技术服务商报告勒索软件影响多个互联系统，暴露72家券商集中托管和灾备连续性风险。
通信基础设施规则修订仍处讨论阶段，NTA官网尚未发布新的生效文本；通信部长此前提出的韧性数字化方向也未形成预算或招标。
本期应重点跟踪 NEPSE/券商生态的正式事故调查与恢复采购、NTA规则定稿，以及洪灾通信重建是否进入公开预算和采购程序。
summaryEn: Nepal Telecom is providing free fibre-equipment repair, SIM replacement and disaster-recovery connectivity in flood-affected areas. The measures are operational, but no new procurement budget or supplier has been disclosed.

A data-centre technical failure led Nepal Stock Exchange to halt trading on 21 September, while the brokers' technology provider reported ransomware affecting several interconnected systems. The incident exposes concentration and continuity risks across 72 brokers.

The telecom-infrastructure rule revision remains under discussion and NTA has not published a new effective text. The communications minister's resilience agenda also remains a policy signal without a budget or tender.

Priority follow-up is the formal NEPSE/broker incident review and any recovery procurement, finalisation of the NTA rules, and whether flood communications reconstruction enters a public budget and procurement process.

items.title: 尼泊尔电信扩大洪灾通信保障：免费修复光纤、补卡并打通灾备链路
items.titleEn: Nepal Telecom expands flood communications support and disaster-recovery links
items.text: 事实：Radio Nepal、eKantipur 和 Technology Khabar 均引述 Nepal Telecom 9月21日公告称，公司正为 Rasuwa、Dhading、Gorkha、Chitwan、Nuwakot、Tanahun 等受灾地区及相关道路走廊提供额外通信保障。措施包括免费更换或安装损坏的 NT Fiber 线缆和路由器、对已到期服务免费延长3个月、按最近五个呼叫号码核验后补发 SIM 并更新 KYC，以及配合尼泊尔军方向救援行动提供210张含套餐的 SIM。公司还为国家减灾与风险管理局主备服务器提供免费暗光纤物理连接，并向部分救援中心和地方行政机构提供高速互联网。报道所称约2亿尼泊尔卢比为公司过往多类救灾援助总额，不是本次网络设备采购预算。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, eKantipur and Technology Khabar cite Nepal Telecom's 21 September notice on additional communications support across flood-affected areas including Rasuwa, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, Nuwakot and Tanahun and associated road corridors. Measures include free replacement or installation of damaged NT Fiber cable and routers, a three-month extension for expired services, SIM reissue after last-five-number verification and KYC update, and 210 packaged SIMs supplied with the Nepal Army for rescue communications. Nepal Telecom is also providing free dark-fibre physical connectivity between the disaster authority's primary and backup servers and high-speed internet at selected relief and administration sites. The reported roughly NPR 200 million is cumulative aid across previous relief categories, not a budget for this equipment programme.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：Nepal Telecom、NDRRMA、地方行政机构和灾区用户需要恢复接入、主备连接及应急通信；当前阶段是已执行的救灾与业务恢复，不是公开采购。竞争研判：报道没有披露设备厂商、系统集成商、招标、合同或中标结果，不能据此认定任何厂商参与。下一步：跟踪 Nepal Telecom、NDRRMA、PPMO 和地方政府是否发布灾后网络重建、数据中心互联、备件或运维采购。证据缺口：新增预算、技术规格、采购主体、交付期限和供应商均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: Nepal Telecom, NDRRMA, local administrations and affected users need access restoration, primary-backup connectivity and emergency communications. The present stage is executed relief and service restoration, not a public procurement. Competition: no equipment vendor, integrator, tender, contract or award is disclosed, so supplier participation cannot be inferred. Next action: monitor Nepal Telecom, NDRRMA, PPMO and local authorities for post-disaster network reconstruction, data-centre interconnect, spares or managed-service procurement. Gaps: new budget, technical specification, procuring entity, delivery timetable and supplier remain unknown.
items.badge: 公共广播 + 主流媒体交叉核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: 通信基础设施规则修订仍在讨论，尚未形成有效的新许可框架
items.titleEn: Telecom infrastructure-rule revision remains under discussion
items.text: 事实：Technology Khabar 9月21日报道，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 此前要求尼泊尔电信管理局（NTA）在两天内提交新的通信基础设施规则，但约两个月后仍未完成。NTA 发言人 Min Prasad Aryal 对该媒体表示文本仍在讨论，完成后才会上报。该报道提及草案或涉及大型基础设施、小型基础设施和骨干光纤公司的分类许可，但草案不是生效规则；其关于 NTA 董事会因错误退回文本的说法来自未具名消息源，尚无独立官方确认。NTA 官方法规页目前仍列示《Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations 2074》，未见新规则正式发布。
items.textEn: Technology Khabar reported on 21 September that a replacement telecom-infrastructure regulation remained unfinished roughly two months after Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina instructed Nepal Telecommunications Authority to submit it within two days. NTA spokesperson Min Prasad Aryal told the outlet that the text was still under discussion and would be forwarded when complete. The report says the draft may contemplate separate licensing for large infrastructure, small infrastructure and backbone fibre companies, but the draft is not an effective rule. Its claim that the NTA board returned the text for errors relies on an unnamed source and lacks independent official confirmation. NTA's official regulation page still lists Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations 2074 and does not show a newly enacted replacement.
items.opportunity: 客户与影响：运营商、独立基础设施公司和骨干光纤投资方可能受未来许可分类及基础设施共享规则影响；当前仍是政策起草阶段。竞争研判：没有生效条文、许可申请、招标、预算或获批公司，不能据媒体描述建立市场份额或项目判断。下一步：持续核查 NTA、MoCIT 和 Nepal Gazette 的正式文本、咨询文件及实施日期。证据缺口：最终许可类别、数量、资本要求、共享义务、过渡安排和审批时间均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and impact: operators, independent infrastructure companies and backbone-fibre investors may be affected by future licence categories and sharing rules; the process remains at policy-drafting stage. Competition: there is no effective text, licence application, tender, budget or approved company, so the media description cannot support market-share or project conclusions. Next action: monitor NTA, MoCIT and the Nepal Gazette for the official text, consultation documents and effective date. Gaps: final licence classes, number of licences, capital requirements, sharing obligations, transition rules and approval timing are unknown.
items.badge: 媒体报道 + NTA官网核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: 通信部长提出“韧性数字化”五项优先方向，灾害期间服务连续性进入政策核心
items.titleEn: Communications minister sets five priorities for resilient digital transformation
items.text: 事实：尼泊尔公共广播 Radio Nepal、Digital Nepal Conclave 官方议程及 Technology Khabar 显示，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 于9月20日在拉利特普尔举行的 Digital Nepal Conclave 2026 上表示，数字化不仅是技术扩展和政务现代化，还应在灾害与危机中维持信息、通信及公共服务。他提出五项优先方向：信息可信与公众信任、可靠且包容的连接、政府机构互操作、以公民为中心的数字服务，以及负责任的人工智能与数据治理。此次讲话是政策方向，不是已批准的预算、建设项目、招标或设备授标。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, the official Digital Nepal Conclave programme and Technology Khabar report that Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina told the 20 September event in Lalitpur that digital transformation must extend beyond technology expansion and service modernisation to maintain information, communications and public services during disasters and crises. He identified five priorities: information integrity and public trust, reliable and inclusive connectivity, interoperability among government bodies, citizen-centred digital services, and responsible AI and data governance. The speech sets policy direction; it is not an approved budget, deployment project, tender or equipment award.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：相关政府机构未来可能把业务连续性、互操作、安全和灾备要求纳入数字战略，但讲话没有确认实施主体、预算或采购范围，因此目前不是可直接计入销售管道的商机。竞争研判：会议信息列出支持方和展示企业，不能据此认定任何公司已获项目、成为投标方或形成设备选型。下一步：跟踪 MoCIT 及相关机构的实施方案、年度预算、PPMO采购公告、政府架构与数据治理标准，以及会后正式记录；只有出现明确责任单位、资金或采购文件后再建立客户机会。证据缺口：时间表、预算、技术架构、采购路径、供应商、合同及历史执行记录均未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: relevant government bodies may incorporate continuity, interoperability, security and recovery requirements into future digital strategies, but the speech confirms no implementation owner, budget or procurement scope. It is therefore not a directly actionable sales opportunity. Competition: the event lists supporters and exhibitors; participation does not establish an award, bidder status or equipment selection. Next action: monitor MoCIT and relevant agencies for implementation plans, annual budgets, PPMO procurement notices, government architecture and data-governance standards, and formal post-event records. Create a customer opportunity only after a responsible agency, funding or procurement document is identified. Gaps: no timetable, budget, architecture, procurement path, supplier, contract or implementation history was disclosed.
items.badge: 官方议程 + 公共广播核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: 数据中心故障致尼泊尔股市停摆，72家券商暴露集中托管与灾备风险
items.titleEn: Data-centre failure halts Nepal stock trading and exposes resilience risk across 72 brokers
items.text: 事实：Nepal Stock Exchange（NEPSE）依据交易规则21(1)于9月21日暂停常规交易，官方对外说明为 DataHub Pvt Ltd 数据中心的技术问题尚未解决；该中心托管72家券商服务器，问题自9月20日上午出现。Kathmandu Post 后续报道称，为券商管理交易系统的 YCO 向相关机构通报，持续的勒索软件攻击影响交易管理系统、CDSC相关系统、支付网关及其他互联服务，受影响系统已被隔离。由于 NEPSE 公开表述仍为“技术问题”，勒索软件成因及是否发生数据泄露应视为 YCO/DataHub 信息经媒体转述，尚待正式取证结论。OnlineKhabar 亦核实券商协会请求停市，以避免继续交易影响交易所系统。
items.textEn: Nepal Stock Exchange suspended regular trading on 21 September under Rule 21(1), publicly citing an unresolved technical problem at DataHub Pvt Ltd, which hosts servers for 72 brokers; the disruption began on the morning of 20 September. Kathmandu Post subsequently reported that YCO, the provider managing brokers' trading systems, notified stakeholders that an ongoing ransomware attack had affected the trading management system, CDSC-related systems, payment gateways and other interconnected services, and that affected systems had been isolated. Because NEPSE's public wording remains 'technical problem', ransomware causation and any data-exfiltration scope should be treated as YCO/DataHub information reported by the newspaper pending a formal forensic conclusion. OnlineKhabar also verified that the brokers' association requested suspension to avoid affecting the exchange system.
items.opportunity: 客户与需求：NEPSE、券商、DataHub/YCO及证券市场基础设施需要可验证的多站点灾备、不可变备份、网络与身份隔离、安全监测、事件响应和定期演练。当前阶段是故障处置与调查，不是公开采购。竞争研判：现有报道没有披露未来采购主体、预算、招标、技术路线、入围厂商或合同；不能把 DataHub、YCO 或任何设备商直接视为买方或中标方。下一步：跟踪 NEPSE、SEBON、CDSC、券商协会及 PPMO 的事故报告、恢复要求和采购公告，并确认是否形成统一行业韧性标准。证据缺口：攻击入口、数据影响、恢复点/时间目标、现有架构、预算和采购日程均未知。
items.opportunityEn: Customers and need: NEPSE, brokers, DataHub/YCO and securities-market infrastructure require tested multi-site recovery, immutable backup, network and identity isolation, security monitoring, incident response and regular exercises. The current stage is incident response and investigation, not a public procurement. Competition: reporting identifies no future buyer, budget, tender, architecture, shortlisted supplier or contract; DataHub, YCO or any equipment vendor cannot be treated as buyer or awardee. Next action: follow NEPSE, SEBON, CDSC, the brokers' association and PPMO for incident findings, recovery requirements and procurement notices, and verify whether a common sector-resilience standard emerges. Gaps: entry vector, data impact, recovery objectives, current architecture, budget and procurement timing are unknown.
items.badge: NEPSE说明 + 双媒体核验 · Tier 1/2

items.title: UTL 牌照取消：先确认监管状态，再评估资产与债权
items.titleEn: UTL cancellation: verify regulatory status before asset or credit decisions
items.status: 官方取消通知已发布；资产处置结果未确认
items.statusEn: Official cancellation notice published; disposal outcome unconfirmed
items.summary: NTA发布题为UTL牌照自动取消的紧急通知。本期公告与9月4日续期截止是不同时间点；基础设施移交的媒体报道不等于每项资产的最终权属结论。
items.summaryEn: NTA published an urgent notice of UTL's automatic licence cancellation. The notice and the earlier renewal deadline are distinct milestones. Media accounts of handover do not settle title to every asset.
items.businessImpact: 业务影响（研判）：相关供货和债权交易需重新核查交易对手权限、付款保障及担保物；不推断政府承担全部债务。
items.businessImpactEn: Business implication (analysis): reassess counterparty authority, payment security and collateral. Do not infer government assumption of all liabilities.
actions: 取得官方通知及后续处置文件，交当地律师核查适用条款与救济状态。
在权属与债权顺位确认前，不以旧牌照或新闻报道作为新增授信依据。
actionsEn: Obtain the notice and subsequent orders; ask local counsel to verify applicable provisions and any challenge.
Do not extend credit on the strength of the former licence or press reports before confirming title and creditor priority.

items.title: 800MHz 竞价说明会：程序公告不是频谱许可
items.titleEn: 800 MHz pre-bid notice is not a spectrum authorization
items.status: 投标前程序公告；未确认授标
items.statusEn: Pre-bid procedural notice; no award confirmed
items.summary: 公告将说明会安排在9月18日尼泊尔时间16:30。它更新的是竞价准备程序，不证明任何申请人已取得频谱，也不披露设备采购合同。
items.summaryEn: The notice schedules the conference for 18 September at 16:30 Nepal time. It concerns bid preparation, not an applicant's spectrum entitlement or an equipment contract.
items.businessImpact: 业务影响（研判）：网络方案可提前准备，但合同生效、交付和融资安排应关联实际获许可及客户预算。
items.businessImpactEn: Business implication (analysis): prepare network options, but condition delivery and financing on actual authorization and customer budget.
actions: 取得正式RFA及答疑／修订版本，核对资格、保证金、频段和时限。
会后核验纪要与后续决定；不得用竞价邀请替代频谱授予文件。
actionsEn: Obtain the RFA and amendments; check eligibility, security, band details and deadlines.
Verify minutes and later decisions; never substitute an invitation for a spectrum award.

legal.disclaimer: 用于商务风险识别，不构成法律意见。草案、正式公布、生效与执行须分别核验。
legal.disclaimerEn: For business-risk awareness, not legal advice. Drafting, publication, commencement and enforcement must be verified separately.

signals.title: Vianet 为 PMGO 电竞赛事提供网络支持
signals.summary: 公开账号可见赛事合作声明，与9月15日新闻相互印证。账号页面仅显示相对发布时间；9月18日为本次核验日期，不冒充发帖日期。链接为账号主页。
signals.impact: 研判：跟进赛事低时延、链路冗余与监控需求；与 ISP 正文为同一事件，不重复计入新闻数量。
signals.summaryEn: The public account carries a partnership announcement corroborating the 15 September report. The account exposes relative timing only. 18 September is the review date, not an asserted post date; this links to the account page.
signals.impactEn: Analysis: follow event latency, redundancy and monitoring needs. This is the same event as the ISP story, not an additional news count.

signals.title: WorldLink 推广 Biz24 企业托管 Wi-Fi
signals.summary: 公开账号动态列出 Rise、Grow、Pro 三类套餐，并邀请企业进行连接评估；官网亦有 Biz24 产品入口。9月18日是核验日期，精确发帖时间待确认；链接为账号主页。
signals.impact: 研判：企业网络售前从带宽转向现场勘测和托管服务；销售方案应强调覆盖、运维及 SLA，而非只比较峰值速率。
signals.summaryEn: A public update lists Rise, Grow and Pro tiers and invites connectivity assessments; the official website confirms the product. 18 September is the review date, with exact posting time unconfirmed. Link: account page.
signals.impactEn: Analysis: enterprise selling is moving toward site surveys and managed operations. Compare coverage, support and SLA, not headline speed alone.

signals.title: Biz24 获行业媒体关注
signals.summary: 媒体公开帖子链接至 Biz24 产品报道，可与9月10日网站文章及 WorldLink 官网比对。此为媒体转述，不是第二份独立采购证据。9月18日为核验日期，非精确发帖时间。
signals.impact: 研判：同一产品事件的多平台传播已归并；不以帖文数量夸大商机热度或新闻数量。
signals.titleEn: Biz24 draws coverage from ICT Frame
signals.summaryEn: The publisher's post points to its Biz24 coverage, which can be compared with the 10 September article and WorldLink's website. This is media distribution, not independent procurement evidence. 18 September is the review date.
signals.impactEn: Analysis: merge cross-platform mentions of the same product. Do not inflate opportunity heat or news counts with reposts.
